about: The Relay's content (rules in relay.js). EVENTS are the canonical record: what happened, what is confirmed, what is unknown, when it becomes public (occurs: at = minutes of play, story = a game event, always). SEGMENTS are reports: lines (spoken in order), kind, optional speaker, headline (screens and archive), event, perspective, standing, priority, stage/after (developing stories), cooldown (minutes; null = once), trigger (real leaderboard moments), systems, when. Script lines marked "draft": true were written by Claude at David's request (2026-10-17) for his review; the rest are David's own lines. Headlines and event summaries are short labels for screens and the archive. After editing: node tools/audio/extract-lines.cjs.

events.summary: A Natural Order EMP attack severely damaged the Nexus AI, the planetary system that ran daily life on The Nexus. The humanitarian crisis continues.
confirmed: The Nexus AI was severely damaged by a Natural Order EMP attack.
Many citizens still struggle with communication, labour, repair and household tasks.
unknown: When, or whether, the central AI can be restored.

events.summary: A major communications disruption was reported near a commercial shipping corridor in the Tessaly System.
confirmed: Several vessels reported intermittent contact with nearby navigation infrastructure.

events.summary: A cargo vessel reported missing was found in its assigned hangar.
confirmed: The search was concluded.
The ship was located in its assigned hangar.

events.summary: A WarFlying enthusiast's six-hour investigation traced an unidentified signal to a malfunctioning coffee maker, which scored one point.
confirmed: The signal came from a malfunctioning coffee maker.
It was awarded one point as a unique electronic source.

events.summary: Maintenance crews at a commercial station repaired a malfunctioning automatic door.
confirmed: The door opened without incident.

events.summary: Ore shipments out of Kepler Exchange were delayed by a loading-crane fault.
confirmed: A loading crane at Kepler Exchange failed during a heavy shift.
Outbound ore shipments were delayed by several hours.
unknown: Whether contracts will be penalised for the delay.

events.summary: Meridian Station completed an upgrade to its water recycling plant.
confirmed: The upgrade finished ahead of schedule.
Water rationing on the lower decks has ended.

events.summary: An accident during a shift change at the Foundry left two workers with minor injuries.
confirmed: Two workers were treated for minor injuries.
Production on one line was paused.
unknown: The cause, pending a safety review.

events.summary: A cargo hauler on the Rusthaven route was reported overdue; it was later found adrift with its crew safe.
confirmed: The hauler missed two scheduled check-ins.
It was found adrift after a navigation fault; all four crew are safe.
unknown: Why its distress beacon did not activate.

events.summary: Natural Order settlements in the Garrow System reported a strong harvest.
confirmed: Settlements report above-average yields.
unknown: How much will be traded outside Garrow.

events.summary: Communion researchers at The Vigil announced an improved medical diagnostic network.
confirmed: The Communion has announced the system.
unknown: Independent results have not been published.

events.summary: Meridian Station’s lost-and-found reported a record number of single gloves.
confirmed: Single gloves now outnumber all other items.

events.summary: An independent courier delivered research equipment to The Vigil.
confirmed: The Vigil confirmed receipt of the shipment.

events.summary: An independent courier delivered industrial parts to Holdfast.
confirmed: Holdfast confirmed receipt of the shipment.

events.summary: Recovery supplies reached The Nexus aboard an independent ship.
confirmed: Supplies were received by recovery coordinators on The Nexus.
unknown: The ship and pilot were not named.

segments.headline: Communications disruption near Tessaly shipping corridor
lines: We interrupt our regularly scheduled programming with a developing report from the Tessaly System.
A major communications disruption has been reported near a commercial shipping corridor.
Authorities have not confirmed the cause. Several vessels are reporting intermittent contact with nearby navigation infrastructure.
More information as it becomes available.

segments.headline: Communion: restoring The Nexus is a humanitarian responsibility
lines: Progress is not the enemy of humanity.
Across The Nexus, families continue to endure the consequences of an attack against the systems that once supported their daily lives.
Restoration is not merely a technological objective. It is a humanitarian responsibility.
The Communion remains committed to rebuilding what was lost.

segments.headline: Natural Order: technology should be understandable, repairable and accountable
lines: A machine should serve the people who built it.
Across our settlements, engineers, farmers, and technicians continue to demonstrate that reliable infrastructure does not require surrendering every decision to a central intelligence.
We believe technology should be understandable, repairable, and accountable.
Progress belongs to humanity.

segments.headline: An unscheduled transmission
lines: Every system produces a pattern.
Every pattern contains a deviation.
Every deviation is eventually observed.
Continue.

segments.headline: Missing cargo vessel found in its own hangar
lines: Authorities have concluded their search for a cargo vessel reported missing yesterday.
The ship was located earlier today.
In its assigned hangar.
The captain has declined to comment.

segments.headline: Six-hour WarFlying hunt ends at a coffee maker
lines: A WarFlying enthusiast has reportedly spent six hours investigating an unidentified electronic signal.
The signal was eventually traced to a malfunctioning coffee maker.
The discovery was awarded one point after officials confirmed it represented a unique electronic source.
Organizers have declined to comment on the competitive implications.

segments.headline: Station celebrates a working door
lines: Maintenance crews at a commercial station have announced the successful repair of a malfunctioning automatic door.
The door reportedly opened without incident.
Officials described the event as a major operational milestone.

segments.headline: {name} moves into {rank} place
lines: LADIES AND GENTLEMEN, WE HAVE A DEVELOPMENT!
{name} has discovered an unregistered navigation beacon!
THAT’S ONE POINT!
ONE!
AND THAT SINGLE POINT HAS MOVED {NAME} INTO {RANK} PLACE!
ABSOLUTELY UNBELIEVABLE!

segments.headline: {name} climbs {positions}
lines: Nobody believed {name} could make a comeback!
Critics called the season finished!
But after discovering {count} previously unrecorded electronic signals, {name} has climbed {positions}!
{COUNT} SIGNALS! {COUNT} POINTS!
THIS IS WHY WE WATCH WARFLYING!

segments.headline: WarFlying coverage
lines: Today’s WarFlying coverage is brought to you by the people who insist they’re not tracking anybody!
Remember, folks: a single sighting means very little!
Several thousand sightings, however, can make for a fascinating travel history!
BACK TO THE LEADERBOARD!

segments.headline: A new contender enters the WarFlying standings
lines: WE HAVE A NEW CONTENDER!
A previously unranked pilot has entered the WarFlying standings!
Nobody knows where this challenger came from!
But one thing is certain!
THE LEADERBOARD WILL NEVER BE THE SAME!

segments.headline: Upgraded maneuvering thrusters
lines: Is your ship turning like a loaded cargo hauler?
Are pirates completing entire conversations while you attempt to maneuver?
Ask your local equipment dealer about upgraded maneuvering thrusters!
Because eventually, you should be facing the thing shooting at you!

segments.headline: Upgrade your defensive systems
lines: Shields taking a beating?
Your hull wasn’t designed to negotiate with incoming laser fire!
Upgrade your defensive systems today!
Remember: repairs cost money. Explosions cost everything!

segments.headline: Missile lock-on technology
lines: Still trying to hit moving targets the old-fashioned way?
Discover the convenience of missile lock-on technology!
Acquire. Lock. Launch.
Because sometimes the problem is moving faster than your patience!

segments.headline: Personal defense equipment
lines: Exploring an abandoned station?
Meeting strangers in poorly lit corridors?
Consider reliable personal defense equipment!
Available from participating licensed equipment dealers.
Because the universe is a dangerous place, and harsh language has limited stopping power!

segments.headline: The Darknet District apparel
lines: Out here, nobody remembers what you wore to your last firefight.
Unless you survived it.
The Darknet District. Apparel for people who prefer their privacy with a little style.
Visit participating retailers for details.

segments.headline: Join the police force
lines: TIRED OF YOUR BORING JOB?
LOOKING FOR ADVENTURE?
JOIN THE POLICE FORCE!
MEET INTERESTING PEOPLE!
VISIT EXOTIC SPACE STATIONS!
ASK COMPLETE STRANGERS WHAT THEY’RE CARRYING IN THEIR CARGO HOLDS!
LAW ENFORCEMENT!
IT’S NOT JUST A CAREER!
IT’S A REASON TO ASK FOR IDENTIFICATION!

segments.headline: A career in law enforcement
lines: Do you enjoy authority?
Do you appreciate paperwork?
Have you ever looked at a perfectly ordinary cargo ship and thought, ‘That deserves an inspection’?
THEN WE HAVE A CAREER FOR YOU!
JOIN THE POLICE FORCE TODAY!
Uniforms provided. Enthusiasm mandatory.
An update on the communications disruption in the Tessaly System.
Engineers have traced the outage to a failed signal amplifier aboard a navigation buoy near the shipping corridor.
Partial service has been restored. Vessels in the area are advised to keep their distance from the buoy until repairs are complete.
segments.headline: Tessaly outage traced to a failed buoy amplifier

lines: A signal stops.
A signal resumes.
The interval was not empty.
segments.headline: An unscheduled transmission

lines: Repairs to the navigation buoy in the Tessaly System are complete, and traffic in the commercial corridor has returned to normal.
Authorities have recorded the incident as an equipment failure. A routine review of the buoy network continues.
segments.headline: Tessaly corridor back to normal after buoy repair

lines: Ore shipments out of Kepler Exchange are running several hours late after a loading crane failed during the evening shift.
Dock supervisors say a replacement part is on its way. Haulers waiting on the Erebus routes are advised to expect delays.
segments.headline: Crane fault delays ore shipments at Kepler

lines: Meridian Station has finished upgrading its water recycling plant, ahead of schedule.
Rationing on the lower decks has ended. Station management thanks residents for their patience, and asks them to stop storing water in their boots.
segments.headline: Meridian water rationing ends after recycler upgrade

lines: Two workers at the Foundry were treated for minor injuries after an accident during a shift change.
One production line has been paused while a safety review is carried out. The cause has not been confirmed.
segments.headline: Two hurt in Foundry shift accident; cause under review

lines: The safety review at the Foundry has found that a pressure valve was fitted backwards during scheduled maintenance.
The paused production line has reopened. New inspection steps have been added to the maintenance checklist.
segments.headline: Foundry review: valve fitted backwards

lines: Search crews are looking for a cargo hauler reported overdue on the Rusthaven route.
The ship has missed two scheduled check-ins. Pilots in the area are asked to keep their sensors open and report any contact.
segments.headline: Hauler overdue on the Rusthaven route

lines: The cargo hauler reported overdue on the Rusthaven route has been found.
It was drifting after a navigation fault. All four crew members are safe and in good spirits, though one has asked never to hear the words “manual course correction” again.
Investigators are looking into why the ship’s distress beacon failed to activate.
segments.headline: Overdue hauler found adrift; all four crew safe

lines: Meridian Station’s lost-and-found office reports a new record.
Single gloves now outnumber every other item in its care.
The whereabouts of the matching gloves remain unknown. The office has asked anyone with information to come forward.
segments.headline: Meridian lost-and-found sets a single-glove record

lines: Natural Order settlements in the Garrow System are reporting a strong harvest, with yields above the seasonal average.
Settlement councils say surplus may be offered for trade later in the season.
segments.headline: Garrow settlements report a strong harvest

lines: This season, our farmers fed our settlements with soil, water, and work.
No central intelligence planned it. No machine took the credit.
We built what we needed, and we can repair what we built.
segments.headline: Natural Order: a harvest built by hand

lines: Communion researchers at The Vigil have announced an improved medical diagnostic network, which they say can identify illness earlier and with fewer errors.
Independent results have not yet been published.
segments.headline: The Vigil announces a new diagnostic network

lines: A diagnosis that comes an hour earlier is an hour given back to a family.
The work at The Vigil is not about machines. It is about the people they serve.
We will share what we learn.
segments.headline: Communion: earlier diagnosis gives time back to families

lines: Recovery work continues on The Nexus, where the loss of its central AI still affects communication, repair, and everyday life.
Communion officials say restoring the system is a humanitarian priority. Natural Order representatives say the population should not depend on it again.
Neither position settles the question of when, or whether, the central AI can be restored.
segments.headline: Nexus recovery continues; its future remains disputed

lines: The people of The Nexus deserve systems they can understand and repair with their own hands.
We have the tools. We have the knowledge. We will share both with anyone willing to learn.
segments.headline: Natural Order: The Nexus deserves systems people can repair

lines: The Vigil has confirmed the arrival of a shipment of research equipment, delivered by an independent courier.
Communion officials described the delivery as uneventful, which they say is exactly how they like them.
segments.headline: Research shipment arrives at The Vigil

lines: Holdfast has confirmed the arrival of a shipment of industrial parts, delivered by an independent courier.
A Holdfast supervisor said the parts arrived on time, which he called “a refreshing change.”
segments.headline: Industrial parts arrive at Holdfast

lines: Recovery supplies have reached The Nexus aboard an independent ship.
Recovery coordinators say the shipment will go to districts where communication and repair services are still limited.
segments.headline: Recovery supplies reach The Nexus

lines: Public information for travellers.
Relay service is not available during warp between systems.
Messages and broadcasts will resume when your ship arrives. Thank you for travelling safely.
segments.headline: Reminder: no Relay service in warp

lines: A reminder for our new viewers!
In WarFlying, every unique signal is worth exactly one point!
No bonuses! No multipliers!
Just pure, unfiltered, one-point glory!
segments.headline: WarFlying: one signal, one point

lines: Lost again?
Is your star chart older than your co-pilot?
Upgrade your navigation suite and find your destination the first time!
Because “I think it was left at the nebula” is not a flight plan!
segments.headline: Navigation suites

lines: Dents happen.
Scrapes happen.
Small holes in the hull happen, briefly.
Professional hull repair at participating stations. Fly in damaged. Fly out a little less damaged.
segments.headline: Hull repairs

lines: Long haul? Short temper?
Rent a sleep pod at participating stations.
Quiet. Clean. Approximately your size.
Wake up rested, or at least horizontal.
segments.headline: Sleep pods
